name: daily_exhausted
description: Small simulated daily token budget on the gate (TPD 40000, RPD 200) so the day budget runs out mid-run while requests are both queued and in flight. Simulated exhaustion only; the real account's daily budget is never targeted.
limits_note: Gate and stand-in minute limits are workload-scaled synthetic values (stand-in 120 RPM / 60000 TPM, gate at 80%), not real Groq limits, so a 3-minute run yields enough requests. Real header-advertised values are in experiments/limits_evidence.json.
